text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 Plus radio station's noon news report on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Patriarch of the Russian Orthodox church Aleksey II has arrived for a three-day visit. He will meet President Algirdas Brazauskas and Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius.
- European Affairs Minister Laima Andrikiene resigned from the post as chairman of the foreign loan panel in protest a the ineffective use of such credits.
- The Lithuanian scouts organisation will be officially accepted by the international scouts' organisation after a 57-year break.
